brief:
Israeli tourists were documented mocking and harassing an American waitress at a restaurant, Eye on Palestine reported. The group initially offered polite compliments to her face before switching to insults in Hebrew when she turned away. They recorded the interaction and shared it online in an apparent attempt to generate viral social media engagement.

The incident reflects what the report characterizes as a broader wave of arrogance and racism among certain Israeli tourists. The waitress faced ridicule directed at American cuisine while simultaneously enduring covert verbal abuse delivered in Hebrew, captured on video and distributed across social platforms. The tourists' documented behavior suggests a pattern of performative politeness concealing contemptuous treatment.
